summary:
Congress rejected a rule from the National Park Service about motor vehicles at Glen Canyon National Recreation Area.

The National Park Service is the government agency that manages many national parks and recreation areas. Glen Canyon National Recreation Area is a public land area in the western United States.

The rule was listed in the Federal Register on January 13, 2025. The Federal Register is where the government publishes official rules and notices.

This law says that the rule has “no force or effect.” That means the rule will not be used and will not become law. The bill does not create a new vehicle rule. It only cancels the National Park Service rule about motor vehicles at Glen Canyon.

Congress passed this joint resolution. A joint resolution is a kind of bill that can become law. It was approved on May 23, 2025.
